eps.t: When I Returned Home, I'd Become a Hero
eps.ov: Luck stays behind to fight Demons so his friends can escape, but the battle lasts longer than he anticipates!

eps.t: There Was a Formidable Foe Deep Inside the Den
eps.ov: Lock and Sia uncover a vampire plot that suggests the kingdom isn't as safe and peaceful as everyone believes.

eps.ov: When they find out a vampire high lord is after Gerberga, Lock and friends start planning a counterattack.

eps.ov: Once the royal palace comes under attack, Lock decides it's time to take the fight to the vampire high lord.

eps.ov: Lock's life takes some unexpected turns after the battle against the vampire high lord.

eps.t: The Trespasser and the Secret Passageway

eps.t: Mythical Beasts That Lurk in the Darkness
eps.ov: Lock and the gang investigate the sewers when Ario and Ginny take too long coming back from a quest.
Lock takes it personally when there's a vampire assault on his home. He and Eric launch a counterassault.

eps.ov: Lock faces off against one of the dark gods, while his friends fight vampires and help however they can.
